selection: Only the three representatives from the completed small structural audit, their five proposed mutation mates, and retained positive controls. No broad panel or quotient campaign.
models: First deterministic cut for each root. P=<u,v|v^-1 u^-2 v^-1 u>, t=u^2v, hP=u^3, eP=v hP^-1. Q233: t=x^-2y, hQ=y^3, x^2=y t^-1, a=x hQ. Q239: t=x^3y, hQ=y^3, x^3=t y^-1, a=x^-1 hQ. Q253: t=y^2x^2, hQ=x^3, y^2=t x^-2, a=y hQ. Proposed chain D(2,3)--A(m)--D(2,3), m=2,3,2. In central outer basis(a,f), (eP,hP) have columns [[2,3],[-1,-2]], [[-1,-2],[0,-1]], [[-1,-3],[1,2]]. These are conjectured exact identities to check, not accepted conclusions.
rank_gate: BW05 Theorem2 has only one three-JSJ-piece type, case6: central two-bridge link exterior, adjacent fibers identified with its meridians. A two-component two-bridge link has unknotted components; filling either meridian leaves a solid torus. Central filling on the P-fiber slope has quotient C_m*C_abs(r), where r=3,-2,-3 in the outer(a,f) basis, hence is nonabelian and cannot be a solid torus. This requires exact source-to-peripheral identities, boundary injection, canonical JSJ and the written classical-import argument.
method: Independently replay all five small-audit core reductions and fourteen fragment reductions, physical arc classes, joins, every balanced four-port cut and selected checkerboards. Check three exact root-amalgam models and every port by complete normal forms, including the conjugation on Q233. Check two inverse peripheral gluing directions, primitive matrices, nonparallel fibers and explicit S3 quotients of the three central fillings. Search five Tait graph Whitney2isomorphisms with the existing exact bounded search; independently check every switch and complete binary cycle space. Replay all eight individual upper4 seed traces.
acceptance: No rank or knot closure from a three-piece count alone. Both the meridional filling obstruction and all uniform topology/classification steps must be written. Mutation transfers only ordinary cover rank; upper4 is checked separately for every knot. A cap leaves that transfer unproved. Positive controls must include genuine three-piece rank2 examples allowed by BW case6, and altered ports/slopes must reject.
scope: At most eight remaining original targets. Full MRC, worldwide novelty/priority, exhaustive literature, formal and external verification remain open. No edits to the already frozen four-piece source data or catalogue.
